poll.source_locator: 'This poll of 469 Florida U.S. Congressional District 14 likely voters was conducted on July 14-15, 2026 ... boundaries ... as adopted in May of 2026'; ballot: Mike Beltran 37.5%, Kathy Castor 46.2%, Undecided 16.4%; MoE 4.5%
poll.notes: out_of_window (field end Jul 15); written because no FL-14 poll with fieldwork on/after Sep 1 is verifiable from a free source (Emerson/Poll Vault Oct 12-14 Castor 48 Beltran 43 is paywalled; see README). Sample drawn on the May 2026 district lines. Respondents saying they would not vote were excluded.

pollster.weighting_quote: weighted to account for proportional differences between the respondents' demographics and the demographics of the active voter population ... The weighting demographics used were: political party, race, age and gender.
pollster.mode: automated phone call polling system and a manual P2P SMS polling system (phone 37%, SMS 63%)
